title: Backlink Profile & Risk Engine
subtitle: Analyze referring domains, anchor distribution, dofollow link equity and potential manipulative footprints.
notConnectedDesc: SEOX AI supports DataForSEO, Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz, and Majestic adapters. Without an API key, this module stays in unconfigured mode and will never display synthetic links.
methodologyNote: Low domain authority alone does NOT constitute toxic backlink risk. Evaluation analyzes manipulative patterns, unnatural anchor concentrations, sitewide repetition, and sudden spikes.
